blurb: Catalina Express operates daily round-trip ferry service to Catalina Island from Long Beach, Dana Point, and San Pedro. Travel times vary by route, approximately 1 hour from Long Beach and 1 hour 15 minutes from San Pedro. They offer various ticket types including adult, senior, child, infant, and upgrades such as the Captain’s Lounge.
